name: finance-ledger
description: Obsidian plugin that renders hledger journals as filterable ledger tables with balance and category dashboards, transaction triage, and categorizer-rule management.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && mkdir -p "${OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN_DIR:?Set OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN_DIR to <vault>/.obsidian/plugins/finance-ledger}" && cp manifest.json main.js styles.css "${OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN_DIR}"/
scripts.typecheck:scripts: if test -d ../../tools/obsidian-cdp; then tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit; else echo 'typecheck:scripts uebersprungen: ../../tools/obsidian-cdp fehlt (maintainer-lokal)'; fi
scripts.gate: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.shots:check: if test -f ../../../_docs/readme/readme_lint.py; then python3 ../../../_docs/readme/readme_lint.py .; else echo 'shots:check uebersprungen: _docs fehlt (maintainer-lokal)'; fi
